title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior AWS
description:
Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (AWS)


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto na área de Dados, em um de nossos maiores clientes, com foco em Engenharia de Dados voltada a AWS , por meio de contrato PJ.


Perfil Técnico Esperado:

  • Experiência prática com data lakes, data mesh e serviços da AWS , incluindo Amazon Web Services (AWS Glue, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3).
  • Capacidade de desenvolver APIs e implementar soluções utilizando PySpark em ambientes como Databricks e EMR.
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de recursos e clusters na AWS.
  • Desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de pipelines de dados , incluindo arquitetura Lambda.
  • Estruturação e gestão de arquitetura de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e condução de sessões de transferência de conhecimento (KT) das soluções implementadas.
  • Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis como Scrum, Kanban e Lean.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações da AWS: Certified Data Engineer – Associate .


Escopo de Atuação:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados conforme demandas do projeto.
  • Estruturar e aprimorar a arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Garantir a documentação técnica das soluções entregues.
  • Realizar transferência de conhecimento das implementações realizadas à equipe interna, quando aplicável.

title: Legal Architect (Remote)
description:
About Lovie

Lovie is an AI-powered platform that helps anyone, anywhere launch a US company.

We build for solopreneurs, creators, and vibe coders — people who move fast, think independently, and use AI as a creative partner.

We’re a small, remote-first team building calm, powerful infrastructure for the next generation of internet builders.

What This Role Is

You are the legal architect of our company formation engine.

Your job is to turn complex US legal requirements into clean, automated, AI-native systems that feel simple and frictionless to founders.

You will own the accuracy, structure, and scalability of our formation service.

What You Absolutely NeedDeep, Hands-On US Formation Experience

You must have real operational experience with:

  • LLC vs C-Corp structures (pros, cons, founder fit)
  • Delaware and Wyoming state filing processes
  • EIN applications and IRS processes
  • BOI reporting requirements
  • Registered Agent requirements
  • Operating Agreements, Bylaws, and core post-formation compliance

You’ve filed, managed, and maintained entities yourself. This cannot be theoretical knowledge.

Systems & Automation Mindset

You:

  • Break complex legal processes into clean, logical workflows
  • Think in systems, not tasks
  • Document clearly and structure information well
  • Obsess over eliminating friction

If something is repetitive, your instinct is to automate it.

Strong Vibe Coding Energy (Non-Negotiable)

You don’t need to be a software engineer — but you think like one.

You:

  • Use AI tools daily
  • Prototype solutions before escalating
  • Enjoy no-code / low-code tools
  • Treat AI as a collaborator, not a novelty
  • Care about flow, elegance, and simplicity

You believe great infrastructure should feel invisible.

Clear Communication

You can:

  • Explain complex legal topics in plain English
  • Write structured documentation
  • Operate effectively in async, remote environments
Lovie Culture

We are:

Life-First.

We optimize for energy, not hours. Autonomy is default.

Calm Builders.

We reject hustle culture. We move deliberately and ship thoughtfully.

Low Ego, High Ownership.

No politics. No posturing. Just strong operators building clean systems.

AI-Native.

We don’t bolt AI on top. We build with it from the beginning.

Vibe Coder Friendly.

  • We value intuition, speed, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.

title: LATAM Laywer
description:
Eudia is revolutionising legal work through AI-powered Augmented Intelligence, empowering Fortune 500 legal teams to accelerate decision-making, mitigate risk, and drive strategic growth. With $105M in Series A funding led by General Catalyst, we’re crafting a category-defining platform that fuses AI-driven automation with human expertise, transforming legal departments into engines of innovation.


At Eudia, we move fast. Unlike traditional enterprise software, our teams ship solutions in days, not months—delivering real impact for some of the world’s largest companies. We’re solving one of the most complex, unsolved challenges in AI: bringing trust, accuracy, and security to legal automation. We’re passionate about reshaping the legal industry. If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, take ownership from day one, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI and legal —we’d love to tell you more.


Contract Attorney – LATAM Procurement (Portuguese & English Speaking)

Remote | LATAM | Full-time | 12-Month Contract

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

**Fully Remote 6-month contract**


Qualifications

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3–8 years of enterprise endpoint engineering and administration experience.
  • Enterprise endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM , and co-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Windows 10/11 , Active Directory/GPO, and endpoint security tooling (e.g., CrowdStrike).
  • Experience with Azure VDI services; third-party VDI platforms (e.g., Workspot) preferred.
  • Endpoint hardware experience across HP, Lenovo, Dell, and Apple platforms.
  • Application packaging and deployment for enterprise endpoints; experience with Office 365, Adobe products, browsers, and remote access tools.


Plusses

  • macOS endpoint management experience (Intune, JAMF, Kandji, or similar) preferred.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell ; Power Automate a plus.
  • Experience with SQL querying and reporting; Power BI experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical or laboratory applications is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Copilot Studio) for proof-of-concept or assessment work is a plus.


Job Summary

This role is responsible for the design, engineering, administration, and advanced support of enterprise physical and virtual endpoint environments. The position owns endpoint platform management, device provisioning, application and OS deployment, security hardening, and L3 escalation support using modern endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune and MECM . The role also requires server and cloud-side administration to support endpoint management platforms, monitoring, and associated infrastructure services.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: React Native Developer | Mid
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Construir componentes de interface seguindo o Design System, incluindo temas, variações e estilos específicos para diferentes brands;
  • Desenvolver telas e lógicas essenciais, integrando com BFFs existentes e garantindo padronização e boas práticas;
  • Consumir serviços REST/GraphQL, aplicar interceptors, lidar com autenticação, tratamento de erros e estados de carregamento;
  • Implementar chamadas de rede dentro do módulo centralizado, seguindo padrões de segurança e resiliência definidos;
  • Aplicar o wrapper criado para rastreamento analítico, garantindo uso correto dos eventos e consistência no envio de dados;
  • Aplicar internacionalização (i18n) e formatação regionalizada (moeda, datas, pluralização), suportando PT-BR, EN e ES;
  • Implementar componentes, fluxos e módulos fundamentais do projeto, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência à arquitetura definida pelo Tech Lead;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento da base white label do novo aplicativo, garantindo que a solução esteja preparada para múltiplas marcas;
  • Aplicar testes unitários, criar hooks personalizados, revisar código e contribuir para manter a base enxuta e escalável;
  • Trabalhar em times ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), colaborando com o time técnico e demais áreas do produto.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência sólida com React Native em projetos de médio e grande porte;
  • Forte domínio de TypeScript e boas práticas de tipagem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Context API, Redux ou Zustand;
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST e/ou GraphQL, autenticadas e tipadas;
  • Implementação de componentes reutilizáveis, estilização avançada e integração com Design System;
  • Conhecimento em temas, branding dinâmico e customização white label;
  • Entendimento de navegação complexa com React Navigation (deep links, params tipados, nested navigation);
  • Experiência com Push Notifications, links dinâmicos e permissões de plataforma;
  • Utilização de ferramentas de analytics (Firebase, GA4, etc.) através de wrappers internos;
  • Familiaridade com Git, PRs, code review e padrões de branch;
  • Experiência prévia com arquiteturas modulares e multi-brand (desejável);
  • Experiência com configuração de pipelines CI/CD para mobile (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox) (desejável);
  • Noções de desenvolvimento nativo (Swift/Kotlin) para integração de módulos (desejável);
  • Experiência com publicação, assinatura e gerenciamento na App Store e Google Play (desejável);
  • Vivência com uso de feature flags, remote config e parametrização dinâmica (desejável).

  • Experience working with high-value clients or confidential operations is a strong advantage
  • Strong attention to detail and process-oriented mindset
  • Ability to operate professionally in a private, relationship-driven environment
  • Fluent English; Portuguese is required

  • A discreet, professional working environment with clear responsibilities

title: Ingeniero de soporte
description:
SaaS Support Engineer


Overview and Purpose


As a SaaS Support Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of Markmonitor Group’s growing number of cloud-based services but with specific emphasis on our Microsoft suite of SaaS services. Your focus will be on providing exceptional technical support to end-users, managing SaaS platforms, and managing/enhancing security controls within the scope of the company's ISMS.



SaaS Support

· Manage and administer Markmonitor Group’s SaaS applications with emphasis on our Microsoft 365 and Azure Active Directory implementation and user base.

· Ensure that Microsoft 365 product knowledge is shared with team members on a regular basis and that collectively we build our team knowledge of the 365 ecosystem.

· Stay informed of and promote through prototyping/POCs, new products and features to help with business workflow efficiency, compliance and with opportunities to reduce cost.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect requirements, design, configure, deploy and manage SaaS applications.

· Administer and maintain SaaS platforms, ensuring optimal performance and availability.

· Monitor service health, troubleshoot incidents, and escalate complex issues as needed.


Technical Support

· Provide first line IT technical support to company staff through in person and remote means keeping staff Informed of progress.

· Troubleshoot and resolve user issues related to software functionality, access, and performance.

· Ensure monitoring, prioritizing and triaging of support tickets and promptly establish resolution ownership. Wherever possible owning and resolving tickets within the 1st line team or escalating them where necessary to the appropriate 2nd line support team.

· Working closely with all technology functional teams to onboard systems knowledge and skills needed to resolve more tickets at the front line.

· Purchasing, configuring and managing the company's Windows and Apple based PCs, laptops and printers/peripherals and ensuring the asset register Is maintained.

· Administering the company's VOIP telephone system (BT Cloud).


InfoSec Support

· Implement security best practices across company SaaS services and ensure Inventory of SaaS services Is maintained.

· Working with the IT Operations team to maintain the company's Microsoft Secure Score at 70%+ through effective monitoring and use of adopted security applications and services which Include

o Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

o Microsoft InTune

· Further improve Security Posture through controlled and tested implementation of Secure Score recommendations as they relate to Identity management, data, devices and app management.

· Ensuring full compliance with Markmonitor Group’s ISMS (certified to ISO27701) in general and specifically as It relates to IT technical support services.

· Collaborate with Markmonitor Group’s SOC In the analysis and resolution of security related incidents. These will largely be tracked In our SIEM platform, Microsoft Sentinel.



Other relevant support Activities

· Provide support to the marketing department with respect to the ongoing maintenance of company (wordpress) websites.

· Provide the IT Operations team with project office support to help the team's engineers focus on delivery rather than management.

· Keep the management updated with regular progress/Issues/risks for both project specific or BAU conducted by the technical support team.



Qualifications and Skills

· 2 Years + experience in a relevant role.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field however work experience Is more Important.

· Demonstrable use of administering the Microsoft 365 suite of services used by the company (see skills matrix)

· Proportional understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, including threat detection, incident response, and compliance. Is not expected to be an authority but can demonstrate good industry and technology awareness. Proactively contributing to ongoing improvement in the company’s security posture.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and customer service skills.

· You should demonstrate appropriate skills and knowledge in the use of the following technologies and frameworks.

title: Endpoint Engineer
description:
**Fully Remote 6-month contract**


Qualifications

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3–8 years of enterprise endpoint engineering and administration experience.
  • Enterprise endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM , and co-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Windows 10/11 , Active Directory/GPO, and endpoint security tooling (e.g., CrowdStrike).
  • Experience with Azure VDI services; third-party VDI platforms (e.g., Workspot) preferred.
  • Endpoint hardware experience across HP, Lenovo, Dell, and Apple platforms.
  • Application packaging and deployment for enterprise endpoints; experience with Office 365, Adobe products, browsers, and remote access tools.


Plusses

  • macOS endpoint management experience (Intune, JAMF, Kandji, or similar) preferred.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell ; Power Automate a plus.
  • Experience with SQL querying and reporting; Power BI experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical or laboratory applications is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Copilot Studio) for proof-of-concept or assessment work is a plus.


Job Summary

This role is responsible for the design, engineering, administration, and advanced support of enterprise physical and virtual endpoint environments. The position owns endpoint platform management, device provisioning, application and OS deployment, security hardening, and L3 escalation support using modern endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune and MECM . The role also requires server and cloud-side administration to support endpoint management platforms, monitoring, and associated infrastructure services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, engineer, and support enterprise desktop, laptop, and VDI provisioning services across corporate and laboratory environments using Intune, MECM, and related tools.
  • Administer and support endpoint management infrastructure, including virtual/physical servers and SaaS/PaaS/DaaS platforms, with responsibility for troubleshooting and recovery.
  • Manage endpoint OS, application, security, and feature update packaging and deployment; coordinate with managed service partners as needed.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and reporting solutions for endpoint platforms.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation support for endpoint technologies and supporting management platforms.
  • Apply ITIL v3 practices, SDLC standards, and change/service management processes, including documentation, change control, and incident/problem management.
  • Collaborate with End User Services, Security, and Infrastructure/Cloud teams to align endpoint services with enterprise strategies.
  • Advise business stakeholders on endpoint engineering capabilities, service offerings, and technical feasibility.
  • Contribute to service design, testing, lifecycle management, compliance documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide peer coverage and knowledge sharing as needed.

description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de design
description:
A Bas-alto é um estúdio de design full-service que trabalha com startups internacionais, atuando em projetos contínuos com clientes fixos nas áreas de product design, web design e marketing/growth design.

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Design experiente para trabalhar de perto com o fundador do estúdio em diversos projetos simultâneos. Procuramos alguém confortável em transitar entre diferentes disciplinas, ajudando a conduzir projetos do conceito à execução, mantendo alto nível de qualidade e consistência.


Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o fundador do estúdio em múltiplos projetos ativos
  • Traduzir necessidades, objetivos e problemas em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para delegar à equipe de design
  • Gerenciar projetos, tarefas e entregas em plataformas como Asana, Jira, Clickup e Notion
  • Acompanhar o andamento de projetos de design em produto, web e marketing/growth
  • Ajudar a estruturar fluxos de trabalho, prioridades e cronogramas
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas
  • Colaborar com clientes e participar de reuniões com clientes internacionais (em inglês)


Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em product design e web design , com entendimento profundo de produtos digitais, interfaces web e mobile, fluxos de usuário, arquitetura de informação, usabilidade e boas práticas de UX e UI
  • Capacidade de compreender como aplicações web e mobile funcionam, incluindo noções de front-end (HTML, CSS e funcionamento geral de interfaces) para facilitar a comunicação com equipes de engenharia
  • Experiência sólida em branding e design gráfico , com domínio de composição, tipografia, hierarquia visual e refinamento estético nas entregas
  • Domínio avançado de Figma , incluindo Auto Layout, componentes, variáveis, organização de arquivos e construção de design systems
  • Inglês fluente , escrito e falado. A maior parte dos clientes e da comunicação do dia a dia é em inglês
  • Extrema organização para manejar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e delegar tarefas com clareza
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e lidar com diferentes demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Forte atenção a detalhe e qualidade de execução


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência trabalhando com startups ou empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com design systems em escala
  • Noções de marketing e growth
  • Experiência como designer gráfico, designer de produto ou webdesigner


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário : a negociar, a partir de R$ 5.000+, dependendo da experiência e nível de senioridade. Caso o candidato seja Remuneração extra para execução
  • Remuneração adicional: Caso o/a profissional tenha interesse e expertise para atuar como designer executor em determinados projetos, essa participação poderá ser remunerada separadamente (opcional).
  • Modelo de contratação : CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho : 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo, sem necessidade de presença física
  • Horário de trabalho : Flexível; o foco está na qualidade das entregas, não no período trabalhado.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Na Bring IT, você pode construir uma carreira gratificante, pois estamos comprometidos em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Como Engenheiro(a) De Software Sênior, Você Irá

  • Orientar e dar suporte técnico a outros Engenheiros de Software.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento nas atividades do dia a dia.
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes ou com suas equipes de desenvolvimento, oferecendo orientação e treinamento.

  • Desenvolver customizações dentro do NetSuite para dar suporte a processos de negócios críticos.

  • Gerar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo testes de produto, dados, fluxogramas, diagramas, layouts, comentários de código e outros materiais técnicos.

  • Compreensão de arquitetura de sistemas, design orientado a objetos, frameworks web e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle).

Contract Attorney – LATAM Procurement (Portuguese & English Speaking)

Remote | LATAM | Full-time | 12-Month Contract


Eudia is partnering with a global, market-leading organization in the agribusiness and commodities sector to support its LATAM legal operations. We are seeking a mid-level Contract Attorney with strong procurement experience to join a high-volume, fast-paced contracts team on a 12-month fixed-term contract .


This role focuses on procurement and transportation-related agreements , supporting business stakeholders across LATAM. The successful candidate will work primarily in Portuguese, with the ability to communicate confidently in English in a regional and global environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Contract triage and intake
  • Review, redline, and negotiate procurement contracts (standard templates and third-party paper)
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counterparties

  • Populate and maintain contract templates
  • Manage contract intake and workflows using Onit or similar contract management systems


Scope of Work

  • ~26% General Procurement Agreements
  • (All agreements fall within procurement, including transportation-related contracts.)

  • Qualified lawyer in Brazil , with a Brazilian law license and legal training completed in Brazil
  • Mid-level legal experience in procurement, commercial, or contracts-focused roles
  • Fluency in Portuguese (written and spoken); all contracts and negotiations are conducted in Portuguese
  • Professional working proficiency in English
  • Strong knowledge of local procurement workflows in Brazil/LATAM
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating procurement or commercial agreements
  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management tools (Onit experience preferred)


Additional Information

  • 12-month contract
  • Full-time position
  • LATAM-focused role aligned to Brazil time zone
  • Detailed workflows and processes will be provided during onboarding


If you’re a mid-level procurement-focused contract attorney looking to work with a globally recognized business through Eudia, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Ingeniero de soporte
description:
SaaS Support Engineer


Overview and Purpose


As a SaaS Support Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of Markmonitor Group’s growing number of cloud-based services but with specific emphasis on our Microsoft suite of SaaS services. Your focus will be on providing exceptional technical support to end-users, managing SaaS platforms, and managing/enhancing security controls within the scope of the company's ISMS.



SaaS Support

· Manage and administer Markmonitor Group’s SaaS applications with emphasis on our Microsoft 365 and Azure Active Directory implementation and user base.

· Ensure that Microsoft 365 product knowledge is shared with team members on a regular basis and that collectively we build our team knowledge of the 365 ecosystem.

· Stay informed of and promote through prototyping/POCs, new products and features to help with business workflow efficiency, compliance and with opportunities to reduce cost.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect requirements, design, configure, deploy and manage SaaS applications.

· Administer and maintain SaaS platforms, ensuring optimal performance and availability.

· Monitor service health, troubleshoot incidents, and escalate complex issues as needed.


Technical Support

· Provide first line IT technical support to company staff through in person and remote means keeping staff Informed of progress.

· Troubleshoot and resolve user issues related to software functionality, access, and performance.

· Ensure monitoring, prioritizing and triaging of support tickets and promptly establish resolution ownership. Wherever possible owning and resolving tickets within the 1st line team or escalating them where necessary to the appropriate 2nd line support team.

· Working closely with all technology functional teams to onboard systems knowledge and skills needed to resolve more tickets at the front line.

· Purchasing, configuring and managing the company's Windows and Apple based PCs, laptops and printers/peripherals and ensuring the asset register Is maintained.

· Administering the company's VOIP telephone system (BT Cloud).


InfoSec Support

· Implement security best practices across company SaaS services and ensure Inventory of SaaS services Is maintained.

· Working with the IT Operations team to maintain the company's Microsoft Secure Score at 70%+ through effective monitoring and use of adopted security applications and services which Include

o Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

o Microsoft InTune

· Further improve Security Posture through controlled and tested implementation of Secure Score recommendations as they relate to Identity management, data, devices and app management.

· Ensuring full compliance with Markmonitor Group’s ISMS (certified to ISO27701) in general and specifically as It relates to IT technical support services.

· Collaborate with Markmonitor Group’s SOC In the analysis and resolution of security related incidents. These will largely be tracked In our SIEM platform, Microsoft Sentinel.



Other relevant support Activities

· Provide support to the marketing department with respect to the ongoing maintenance of company (wordpress) websites.

· Provide the IT Operations team with project office support to help the team's engineers focus on delivery rather than management.

· Keep the management updated with regular progress/Issues/risks for both project specific or BAU conducted by the technical support team.



Qualifications and Skills

· 2 Years + experience in a relevant role.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field however work experience Is more Important.

· Demonstrable use of administering the Microsoft 365 suite of services used by the company (see skills matrix)

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Gerente de design
description:
A Bas-alto é um estúdio de design full-service que trabalha com startups internacionais, atuando em projetos contínuos com clientes fixos nas áreas de product design, web design e marketing/growth design.

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Design experiente para trabalhar de perto com o fundador do estúdio em diversos projetos simultâneos. Procuramos alguém confortável em transitar entre diferentes disciplinas, ajudando a conduzir projetos do conceito à execução, mantendo alto nível de qualidade e consistência.


Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o fundador do estúdio em múltiplos projetos ativos
  • Traduzir necessidades, objetivos e problemas em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para delegar à equipe de design
  • Gerenciar projetos, tarefas e entregas em plataformas como Asana, Jira, Clickup e Notion
  • Acompanhar o andamento de projetos de design em produto, web e marketing/growth
  • Ajudar a estruturar fluxos de trabalho, prioridades e cronogramas
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas
  • Colaborar com clientes e participar de reuniões com clientes internacionais (em inglês)


Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em product design e web design , com entendimento profundo de produtos digitais, interfaces web e mobile, fluxos de usuário, arquitetura de informação, usabilidade e boas práticas de UX e UI
  • Capacidade de compreender como aplicações web e mobile funcionam, incluindo noções de front-end (HTML, CSS e funcionamento geral de interfaces) para facilitar a comunicação com equipes de engenharia
  • Experiência sólida em branding e design gráfico , com domínio de composição, tipografia, hierarquia visual e refinamento estético nas entregas
  • Domínio avançado de Figma , incluindo Auto Layout, componentes, variáveis, organização de arquivos e construção de design systems
  • Inglês fluente , escrito e falado. A maior parte dos clientes e da comunicação do dia a dia é em inglês
  • Extrema organização para manejar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e delegar tarefas com clareza
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e lidar com diferentes demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Forte atenção a detalhe e qualidade de execução


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência trabalhando com startups ou empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com design systems em escala
  • Noções de marketing e growth
  • Experiência como designer gráfico, designer de produto ou webdesigner


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário : a negociar, a partir de R$ 5.000+, dependendo da experiência e nível de senioridade. Caso o candidato seja Remuneração extra para execução
  • Remuneração adicional: Caso o/a profissional tenha interesse e expertise para atuar como designer executor em determinados projetos, essa participação poderá ser remunerada separadamente (opcional).
  • Modelo de contratação : CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho : 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo, sem necessidade de presença física
  • Horário de trabalho : Flexível; o foco está na qualidade das entregas, não no período trabalhado.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
